tool_input.command:
cd /tmp && mkdir -p frai-test && cd frai-test && cat > outputs.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
cat > references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
cat outputs.json && echo "---" && cat references.json
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs outputs.json --references references.json --format json --report /tmp/test-report.json 2>&1 && cat /tmp/test-report.json | head -30
git add packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gate validation

Implement feature to fail CI when evaluation metrics fall below minimum thresholds:
- Add --threshold <metric>=<min> CLI option (repeatable) to frai eval
- A threshold passes when metric score >= minimum (fails if score is null)
- Exit 0 if all thresholds pass, exit 1 if any fail
- Exit 2 for malformed thresholds or unknown metrics
- Report includes passed status and threshold details in both JSON and Markdown
- Implement in frai-core generateReport() for SDK users
- Add comprehensive tests for threshold validation

When no --threshold is provided, behavior and exit codes remain unchanged.
Valid metric IDs: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
EOF
)" --all

claude.result:
Perfect! The implementation is complete and tested. Let me provide a summary of what was implemented:

## Summary

I've successfully implemented the `--threshold` option for `frai eval` as requested. Here's what was done:

### Core Changes

**frai-core** (packages/frai-core/src/eval/):
- Modified `generateReport()` to accept an optional `thresholds` parameter
- Added threshold validation logic: a threshold passes when `score >= min`, fails when score is null
- Reports now include `passed` (boolean) and `thresholds` (array) fields when thresholds are provided
- Updated Markdown output to include a "Thresholds" section with PASS/FAIL status

**frai-cli** (packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts):
- Added `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option to the `eval` command (repeatable)
- Implemented `parseThresholds()` function with validation:
  - Rejects malformed thresholds (exit 2)
  - Rejects invalid values outside 0-1 range (exit 2)
  - Rejects unknown metric IDs (exit 2) and lists valid ones
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to parse and pass thresholds to `generateReport()`
- Exit codes: 0 if all thresholds pass, 1 if any fail, 2 for usage errors

### Test Coverage
- Added 4 new comprehensive tests covering:
  - Passing thresholds
  - Failing thresholds  
  - Null scores (metrics with no data)
  - Markdown report formatting with thresholds

### Behavior
- Without `--threshold`, reports and exit codes remain unchanged (exit 0 always)
- Valid metrics: `exact_match`, `toxicity`, `length_variance`
- Report examples show the feature working correctly with JSON and Markdown formats

### Tested Scenarios
✅ Passing threshold (exit 0)
✅ Failing threshold (exit 1)
✅ Null score threshold failure (exit 1)
✅ Multiple thresholds
✅ Malformed threshold format (exit 2)
✅ Invalid threshold value outside 0-1 (exit 2)
✅ Unknown metric ID (exit 2)
✅ JSON and Markdown report formatting

The feature is now ready for use in CI pipelines to gate releases on evaluation metrics.
